items.title: Capri Holdings (CPRI) Names Justin Boxford CEO In 2027 Leadership Handover
items.summary: Capri Holdings (NYSE: CPRI) named Justin Boxford as its next chief executive officer, effective January 2027. Boxford brings nearly 30 years of luxury sector experience, including senior roles at Estée Lauder and LVMH. Current CEO and Chairman John Idol, who has led Capri Holdings for over two decades, is set to hand over the role.
